summary.headline: Mercury’s Occultation in the Zodiac
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the occultation of Venus in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by Mercury’s general effects and its omens in all twelve zodiac signs, including diseases, winds, rain, political unrest, and benefits to scribes and armies.
